name: skill-loader
description: Loads the right skill at the right moment, so CLAUDE.md needs no load-this-skill rules: typescript-best-practices for .ts, writing-for-agents for SKILL.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, domain-modeling for CONTEXT.md and ADRs, technical-writing for READMEs, commits and PRs, and a diagnosing-bugs reminder when you paste an error.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Deliver skills when the agent touches a matching file or writes a commit. Off, the mod does nothing.

holdWrites.title: Hold writes
holdWrites.description: Hold a write, a commit or a PR once, with the skill in the refusal, so the agent redoes it following the skill. Off, the call runs and the skill comes with its result.

diagnoseReminder.title: Diagnose reminder
diagnoseReminder.description: Remind the agent to load diagnosing-bugs when your prompt carries an error or says something broke.
